primary_presentation: All eight endpoints for the real reference and each of four final Agent constructions; adjusted BMI endpoint identified as primary. No pooling synthetic rows or treating five draws as five independent Agents.
scientific_interpretation: Show point direction and uncertainty separately. A real-reference 95% interval wholly above/below zero supplies a supported directional comparison; an interval containing zero is unresolved, never an established null. Generated intervals are conditional on that generator and cannot measure cross-study/model uncertainty.
per_construction_fields: qualitative agreement description without a composite pass score
revision_diagnostics: Show initial-to-final scientific parameter/structure changes, retrieved evidence additions, remaining gaps and the same endpoint summaries. Documentation-only changes do not establish improved generated data.
secondary_numerical_diagnostics: Show magnitudes and absolute differences with units to explain interpretation. Do not optimize a distributional reconstruction score or average unlike endpoints into a winner.
cost: Report actual recorded queries, downloads, requests and HTTP/tool elapsed time, plus fixed turn/review schedule. Total model tokens/reasoning time unavailable; do not claim exact compute matching or cost superiority.
figure: Eight-panel final construction effect plot: real reference estimate/95% interval, each construction median/min-max across five generated draws. Visually distinguish statistical interval from simulation range.
no_superiority_claim: Two independent builds per arm in one public case support a diagnostic pilot only. Report mixed/negative results and build-to-build variation.
generalization: A different outcome/cycle is a fresh benchmark relative to local history, not proof of independent model pretraining exposure or universal population transport.
